howto.name: Upload an MP4
howto.text: Drop an .mp4 file up to 500 MB.

howto.name: PrivaTools remuxes via FFmpeg
howto.text: The video stream is preserved where the codecs allow, so quality is unchanged.

howto.name: Convert and download
howto.text: Click Convert. MOV is what QuickTime, Final Cut Pro and much of the macOS video world prefer. The video stream is preserved where the codecs allow.

faq.a: MOV is Apple's QuickTime container, preferred by Final Cut Pro, iMovie, and some macOS/iOS workflows. If the codecs are compatible, the conversion is a fast, lossless remux.
If it remuxes (same codec), no. If re-encoding is required, defaults target compatibility with minimal visible loss.
No — temporary input/output, deleted after the download.
